subject: Re: Continuity attestation — third-party dependency mapping & failback proofs
messages:
From: Claire Hughes <claire.hughes@eastbridge.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>
Cc: ops+security@eastbridge.com
Date: 2026-06-14T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Third-party dependency inventory and failback evidence request

Hi Mina,

Thanks again for the quick call this morning. As part of EastBridge's SIG/BCP assessment we need a concise set of artifacts to verify your recovery commitments across third-party dependencies. Specifically, can you provide: 

- A dependency inventory that lists all critical external services (DNS, KMS, object storage, metrics/observability endpoints, partner model registries) with owners and failover plans.
- Evidence of the most recent warm-cache snapshot(s) used for fast recovery and the timestamps (UTC) for creation + last restore exercise.
- A short runbook excerpt that shows the failback sequence from a warm-standby to the primary region (i.e., the step that reintegrates traffic and replays data).
- Any vendor attestations if a third party is relied upon for backup/restore (signed or emailed confirmations are fine).

Our SOC-2 reviewer would like these within the next 72 hours if possible. If you need to redact secrets, please mark where redactions were made.

Appreciate it — we want to align on scope before the tabletop next week.

Best,
Claire Hughes
Sr. Security Manager
EastBridge Financial

Attachments: none listed
From: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>
To: Claire Hughes <claire.hughes@eastbridge.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-06-14T12:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Third-party dependency inventory and failback evidence request

Claire — thanks for the clear list. We're putting together a compact packet and can hit the 72-hour window. Initial items I'm attaching: a first-pass dependency inventory (dependency_map_v1.csv) and a link to the internal playbook folder.

Quick notes:
- The dependency map has a "criticality" column and owner contact; where we outsource (e.g., RLM model registry), we've flagged the contract owner.
- Warm-cache snapshots are produced nightly; Ben will provide the precise dump timestamps and a short trace showing restore duration from object-store to KV cache.
- Our failback playbook is controlled by ops and has two validated variations depending on whether the primary region is partially available or fully restored. We'll supply the playbook excerpt with redactions for credential material.

I'll follow up with the logs and a concise summary of the observable metrics that prove RTO targets were met during the last exercise.

Mina Haddad
Director, Trust & Safety
Redwood Inference

Attachments:
- dependency_map_v1.csv (inventory, owner contact, impact level)

Reference: https://drive.redwood.com/teams/ops/EB-4832/dependency-map-v1
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>, Claire Hughes <claire.hughes@eastbridge.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-06-15T10:33:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Third-party dependency inventory and failback evidence request

On Mon, Jun 14, 2026 at 12:04 PM Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com> wrote:
> Claire — thanks for the clear list. We're putting together a compact packet and can hit the 72-hour window.

Claire / team — attaching the technical evidence requested. Summary below and attachments included.

What I'm sending:
- warm_cache_snapshot-2026-05-12.json (short metadata extract; keys redacted) — shows snapshot creation at 2026-05-12T03:10:23Z and last restore exercise at 2026-05-12T03:18:45Z.
- failback-playbook-v2.pdf — excerpted playbook pages 4–7 showing the sequence we execute to cut traffic back to primary and the validation probes we run.

Key audit points:
- Measured restore time (object-store -> KV cache warm state) for a 250GB snapshot averaged 8m 22s across three runs (see warm_cache_snapshot-2026-05-12.json, field restore_durations_ms).
- During the May exercise we validated application-level probes (generation latency < 300ms median) within 15 minutes of cutover; that meets our internal RTO of 30 minutes for critical inference endpoints.
- Vendor confirmations: For our object-store backup we rely on CloudHarbor (partner); they provided an operations note confirming retention and expedited restore SLAs — I'm pulling the confirmation email and will forward under separate cover (vendor_attestation_cloudharbor.eml).

Ask / caveat: the playbook PDF has steps that reference internal runbook IDs and ephemeral access tokens — those are redacted. We document where the redactions are in the playbook footer.

If you'd like, we can run a 20-minute walkthrough with ops to demonstrate the restore trace and show the logs live (useful for the reviewer).

Thanks,
Ben Carter
Sr. Site Reliability Engineer
Redwood Inference

Attachments:
- warm_cache_snapshot-2026-05-12.json (metadata extract; keys redacted)
- failback-playbook-v2.pdf (playbook excerpt, redactions noted)
From: Claire Hughes <claire.hughes@eastbridge.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>
Cc: ops+security@eastbridge.com, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-06-16T15:07:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Third-party dependency inventory and failback evidence request

Mina / Ben — this is very helpful, thank you. The timestamps and the restore duration numbers are exactly what our reviewer needed. A couple of quick follow-ups before we close the ticket: 

- Could you forward the CloudHarbor attestation once you have it (we only need the one-paragraph confirmation of restore support and retention).
- Please include the specific runbook excerpt that lists the monitoring probes (we need an unambiguous assertion of the probes and their thresholds for our SOC-2 work). If there are any short internal notes about the last tabletop (less than one page), that would also help.

We'd like to schedule the 20-minute walkthrough you offered. Are you available Thursday 6/18 at 10:00 AM PT? If so, I'll send a calendar invite for the reviewer and ops.

Best,
Claire Hughes
Sr. Security Manager
EastBridge Financial

P.S. Please mark any redactions in the document properties so the reviewer knows what was removed.
